phil-fin: quick flag 1: vendor price sheet change appears to have dropped grandfathering for a tiny cohort. two invoices and a couple support tickets. tagging ops.

anya-ops: can you paste invoice ids?

phil-fin: INV-2025-08-02-5501, INV-2025-08-02-5502 (custs: LITE-11, LITE-12). looks like the `preserve_legacy` column was renamed by vendor.

ryan-eng: we shipped a stricter parser last week that ignores unknown headers. alias table should have covered this but it didn't. i'll check the import logs.

billing-bot: query -> INV-2025-08-02-5501 preserve_legacy=false; INV-2025-08-02-5502 preserve_legacy=false.

marta-revops: experiment service still shows those customers in legacy bucket. so ingest only. i'll prep a dry-run reingest and credit calc.

anya-ops: running dry-run now: `./bin/reingest --rows 5501,5502 --dry-run` output: ```2025-08-03T10:05:01Z INFO scanning 2 rows
2025-08-03T10:05:02Z INFO alias `legacy_preserve` detected for LITE-11 -> preserve_legacy=true
2025-08-03T10:05:03Z INFO INV-2025-08-02-5501 -> credit $5.20 (dry-run)
2025-08-03T10:05:04Z INFO LITE-12 alias detected -> preserve_legacy=true
2025-08-03T10:05:05Z INFO INV-2025-08-02-5502 -> no credit (promo)```

marta-revops: propose live run at 11:00 UTC and a short customer note. olga-legal: include any wording constraints?

olga-legal: keep it factual. avoid language that admits broad liability. route refund > $500 to legal.

phil-fin: please include a pre-import header alias check in the rollout checklist for next 2 vendor feeds. ryan, add the alias to the mapping and a CI test. anya, post dry-run output here and execute live run after signoff.

ryan-eng: opened PR with alias and test: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/427. will wait for QA.

anya-ops: live reingest started at 11:00 UTC. billing-bot: please confirm credits applied.

billing-bot: credit applied INV-2025-08-02-5501 -> $5.20 (account credit). INV-2025-08-02-5502 -> none (promo). status: completed.

marta-revops: customer message drafted: "We apologize for a temporary billing discrepancy caused by a vendor file header change. We've applied an account credit where appropriate; no action required. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." olga-legal approved minor wording edits.

phil-fin: great work. capture a short postmortem and update the vendor-import checklist. closing after postmortem doc assigned. :white_check_mark:
